_comment: Template for creating new benchmark tasks. Copy this file and fill in your task details.
name: your-task-name
description: Brief description of what this task tests

variants.typescript:
Prompt for TypeScript implementation. Be specific about:
- Interfaces and types to define
- Classes or functions to create
- Type safety requirements
- Export requirements
variants.javascript: Prompt for plain JavaScript. Should have identical functionality to TypeScript but without type annotations.
variants.javascript-jsdoc:
Prompt for JavaScript with JSDoc. Include requirements for:
- @typedef type definitions
- @param and @return tags
- @template for generics if needed
- Complete documentation
variants.javascript-vanilla-web:
Prompt for complete web implementation including:
- HTML structure needed
- CSS styling requirements
- JavaScript functionality
- No frameworks or libraries
- Return as single HTML file or clear structure
variants.javascript-vanilla-web-jsdoc:
Same as javascript-vanilla-web but require:
- Complete JSDoc type annotations
- Documented functions and modules
- Type definitions for data structures
variants.typescript-vanilla-web:
Prompt for TypeScript with vanilla Web APIs:
- TypeScript interfaces and types
- DOM manipulation with proper typing
- Event handlers with types
- HTML structure needed
- No frameworks
variants.typescript-react:
Prompt for TypeScript React implementation:
- Component structure
- Props interfaces
- State management approach
- Hooks to use
- Minimal dependencies (React only)
- TypeScript strict mode compatible

testCases.test: // Add more test cases as needed

requirements: _comment: Keywords that should appear in the response

_optionalFields.bugLocation: Where the bug is (for bug-finding tasks)

_instructions.step1: Copy this file to the appropriate category folder in benchmark/tasks/
_instructions.step3: Fill in all fields (remove _comment and _instructions fields)
_instructions.step4: Ensure all variants test the SAME functionality
_instructions.step5: Keep prompts as similar as possible across variants
_instructions.step6: Test your task: node benchmark/index.js --task your-task-name
_instructions.step7: Review the results and adjust as needed

_tips.fairness: Make sure all variants are testing the exact same thing
_tips.clarity: Be specific about requirements in each prompt
_tips.consistency: Use similar wording across variant prompts
_tips.testability: Include test cases or clear expected outputs
_tips.realism: Test real-world scenarios, not contrived examples
_tips.difficulty: Match difficulty to category (simple should be simple)
_tips.documentation: Clearly document what you're testing and why
